name: code_tag
description: GH #3588 / REQ-648. The code record: one physical tag or printed label. value is the text a scanner returns, unique in the tenant over every status (retired included); it may change for a rewritable tag, the old value is kept in code_value_change. kind says what the value was read from and takes no part in uniqueness or resolve. status is not_assigned, assigned or retired (retired for good).
